name: CDB
recent: CelcomDigi 在 2026 年 11 月 19 日公布第三季度业绩，净利按年增长 20% 至 4.08 亿令吉，并宣布每股 3.4 仙的第三次中期股息。公司同时出现董事会变动，以及 EPF 在 11 月多次申报股权变动。
notable: 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，净利按年增长 20% 至 4.08 亿令吉。
宣布第三次中期免税单层股息每股 3.4 仙，除息日为 2026 年 12 月 9 日。
董事会变动：June Solbekk 与 Elisabeth Melander Stene 出任董事。
risks: 新闻标题提及第三季度业绩令人失望，较高成本预计将影响未来两年的盈利增长。
EPF 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报股权变动。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 31.86 亿令吉，按年增长 0.3%，按季下降 0.7%；净利为 3.98 亿令吉，按年下降 9.3%，按季下降 4.8%；净利率为 12.5%，低于上一季度的 13.0%。

recent_en: CelcomDigi announced its 3Q 2026 results on 19 November 2026, with net profit rising 20% year-on-year to RM408 million, and declared a third interim dividend of 3.4 sen per share. The company also saw boardroom changes and several EPF shareholding change notifications in November.
notable_en: Reported 3Q 2026 results with net profit up 20% year-on-year to RM408 million.
Declared a third interim tax-exempt single-tier dividend of 3.4 sen per share, with ex-date on 9 December 2026.
Boardroom changes: June Solbekk and Elisabeth Melander Stene appointed as directors.
risks_en: News headlines noted 3Q results were disappointing and higher costs are expected to impact earnings growth over the next two years.
EPF filed multiple shareholding change notifications between September and November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM3.186 billion, up 0.3% year-on-year and down 0.7% quarter-on-quarter; net income was RM398 million, down 9.3% year-on-year and 4.8% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 12.5%, lower than 13.0% in the previous quarter.
